regime.label: Fearful, no panic
regime.summary: S&P 500 at a 5-month low (7,340.53 Tue) after 4 down days; futures up a little after Nvidia. VIX about 24.7 pre-open. 10-year yield 5.10%, a Dec 9 hike mostly priced. VIX under 30: never sell long-term holdings.

brief: Nvidia's beat gives a small relief bounce after 4 down days, with the Fed minutes at 23:00 Dubai. No lab trade and no rocket today: the red team rejected all 4 candidates; keep the limit orders for SPYM, Eaton and Richemont.

todo.focus: Nvidia beat. Place 3 limit buys, cancel GPN, hold the rest.

items.text: Infineon is WAIT: if the EUR 48.50 order was placed, cancel it
SPYM: limit BUY 6 at $86.22, valid to Fri Nov 20. Cancel any older $89 order
Eaton: limit BUY 1 ETN at $335, valid to Fri Nov 20 (can place now). Cancel if it closes below $327
Nvidia beat and raised: HOLD, no add. Read the deep-dive on its card
No lab trade and no rocket today: the red team rejected all 4. Do not chase the Nvidia bounce

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at CHF 170, valid until Fri Nov 27. Last CHF 173.35 Wed. Keep the limit, do not chase above CHF 175. SIX, or ADR CFRUY.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: BUY 1 with a limit at $335, valid until Fri Nov 20. Cancel it if ETN closes below $327. Can be placed in advance. Tue close $337.11.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), guidance raised. About 14% down in a month on Texas data-center policy and AI fears.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $86.22 (Tue close), valid until Fri Nov 20. Cancel any older $89 order. Then 6 more each week while below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. About 6% below its 6-month high after a -4% month.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia beat and guided $130B
cards.trigger: HOLD. No add. Earliest review of an add: Fri Nov 20 close (2-session rule), and only if it holds above $160.
cards.story: Revenue $115.8B (+103%), but the stock gave back its after-hours jump. Weak spots: lower margin guide, slower cash collection.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit likely filled: GOOGL traded below $288 Mon and Tue (closed $280.20). No second slice for now: WAIT.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. 31% below its high on heavy AI spending worries.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the EUR 48.50 limit if placed. Reconsider Fri Nov 27 only if IFX closed above EUR 46 every day and no new US chip rule hits Europe.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is about 20% below forecasts and Q1 is guided lower.

cards.name: Experian · London
cards.trigger: WAIT. Reconsider after Fri Nov 20 close: BUY up to 12 shares at or below that close, only if above 2,800p and no target cuts.
cards.story: EPS +15% and an extra $500M buyback, but the top of its growth guide was cut. 16.5% below its January high.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT: BUY 2 only with a limit at EUR 235 (last about EUR 240.40 Wed), valid until Fri Nov 27. Paris hours 12:00-20:30 Dubai, or US OTC SBGSY.
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. Closed $359.69 Tue, about $376 pre-market after Nvidia. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM at or below that close if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Salesforce about -8%, SAP -5.6%, Dassault -4.9% Tue. Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%.

cards.name: UnitedHealth
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: the drop comes from a new rule that can cut payments. Reconsider after the comment period ends (Jan 19, 2027).
cards.story: About -5% on a proposed Medicare audit rule reaching back to 2018. The business was improving, but clawbacks are a real risk.

cards.name: Lowe's
cards.trigger: AVOID. Reconsider only after a quarter where profit grows without tariff refunds and comps beat +3%.
cards.story: Down 2-4% pre-market: the beat leaned on tariff refunds and acquisitions, and the margin guide was cut.

cards.name: Nike
cards.trigger: AVOID. Sales are still shrinking. Reconsider only after a quarter with sales growth.
cards.story: -6.3% after its investor day pushed the recovery out. Sales fell 5% and free cash flow did not cover the dividend.

cards.name: Prosus · Amsterdam
cards.trigger: AVOID. No buy before its H1 results on Wed Nov 25; reconsider only if Tencent's profit grows again.
cards.story: -5% to -7% on Tencent's Q3 revenue miss. Tencent is about 73% of its assets and its profit is falling on AI spending.
